UniversityAcademics1.title: Academic
UniversityAcademics1.description: At Crestmont University, our academic programs are designed to inspire curiosity, develop critical thinking, and prepare students for real-world challenges while fostering a learning environment that empowers every individual to grow and achieve their goals.

undergraduate.title: Undergraduate
undergraduate.description: Our undergraduate programs provide a strong academic foundation along with hands-on learning experiences to help students discover their interests and build successful careers.

graduate.title: Graduate
graduate.description: Our graduate programs are designed for in-depth learning, research, and professional development, enabling students to advance their knowledge and make a meaningful impact in their fields.

lifelongLearning.title: Lifelong
lifelongLearning.description: We offer a wide range of continuing education programs, short courses, and certifications to help learners of all ages stay curious and future-ready.

professionalDevelopment.title: Professional
professionalDevelopment.description: We provide training, resources, and mentorship to help students and working professionals enhance their skills, expand their network, and achieve their career goals.

programs.title: B.Tech in Computer Science
programs.description: Build a strong foundation in computing, AI architectures, distributed systems, and modern software engineering.
programs.about: The Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science program is tailored to build strong foundations in computational theory, algorithm design, cloud engineering, and artificial intelligence. Students engage directly in state-of-the-art laboratory environments and real-world deployment stacks.
programs.keyAreas: Core algorithms, distributed systems, database management systems, AI/ML development, cybersecurity protocols, mobile software architectures, and automated cloud computing.

teachingMethods.label: Interactive Code Labs
teachingMethods.text: Continuous hands-on software development with modern developer tooling.

teachingMethods.label: Industry Mentorship
teachingMethods.text: Regular technical roundtables and architecture reviews by principal tech leads.

teachingMethods.label: Capstone Prototyping
teachingMethods.text: Full-cycle production deployment of open-source and proprietary software products.

requirements: Senior Secondary (10+2) with Physics, Mathematics & Chemistry
Minimum 60% aggregate score from a recognized educational board
Qualifying score in University Entrance Examination or State CET

programs.title: Bachelor of Business Administration
programs.description: Cultivate business leadership, strategic finance, brand marketing, and operational management skills.
programs.about: The BBA program at Crestmont provides students with strategic business understanding, leadership frameworks, and analytics-driven decision capabilities across modern corporate ecosystems.
programs.keyAreas: Corporate finance, organizational behavior, global marketing strategy, business analytics, supply chain operations, and ethical entrepreneurship.

teachingMethods.label: Case Study Simulations
teachingMethods.text: Live dissection of Fortune 500 company case studies and business pivots.

teachingMethods.label: Executive Workshops
teachingMethods.text: Intensive strategy sprints driven by guest corporate CXOs.

teachingMethods.label: Corporate Internships
teachingMethods.text: Mandatory industry immersion ensuring practical market readiness.

requirements: Senior Secondary (10+2) in Commerce, Science, or Humanities
Minimum 55% aggregate from a recognized secondary board
Clearance in University Personal Interview round

featuredPost.title: Crestmont University Launches Student Leadership Program
featuredPost.description: An initiative to empower future leaders through mentorship, skills development, and real-world exposure.

posts.title: Guest Lecture on Future Technologies
posts.desc: Applications are now open for undergraduate and postgraduate programs.
posts.description: Join distinguished global tech visionaries and faculty researchers for an interactive guest session exploring artificial intelligence, quantum algorithms, and next-generation cloud networks.
posts.content: This flagship lecture provides undergraduates and graduate scholars with rare insights into the industry frontier, offering open roundtables, Q&A sessions, and project mentorship directly with veteran engineers.

posts.title: Annual Career Fair 2026
posts.desc: Join industry leaders, alumni, and students for a day of ideas, collaboration, and growth.
posts.description: Connect directly with hiring managers, talent recruiters, and enterprise alumni across technology, banking, healthcare, and research domains.
posts.content: Bring printed resumes and digital portfolios to participate in on-the-spot interviews, resume critiques, and structured networking sprints designed to secure premier summer internships and full-time placements.

posts.title: Convocation Ceremony 2026
posts.desc: A proud moment as our graduates step into a brighter future.
posts.description: A celebrated milestone honoring the dedication, scholarly achievements, and graduation of our undergraduate and postgraduate students.
posts.content: Faculty, alumni leaders, and distinguished academic guests gather in ceremonial regalia to confer degrees, present gold medals, and celebrate the accomplishments of the graduating class.

posts.title: Leadership Summit & Speaker Series
posts.desc: Advancing innovation and global collaboration through cutting-edge research.
posts.description: A gathering of corporate heads, social entrepreneurs, and academic deans to debate progressive leadership paradigms and sustainable governance.
posts.content: Engage in keynote addresses, breakout strategy clinics, and collaborative case workshops focused on agile organizational structures and societal problem solving.

posts.title: Spandan Annual Cultural Fest
posts.desc: Annual cultural fest celebrating arts, music, and student talents.
posts.description: A celebration of student creativity, performing arts, musical bands, dance competitions, and fine-arts exhibitions from across universities.
posts.content: Experience dynamic stage acts, battle of the bands, literary debates, and evening celebrity concerts celebrating culture, art, and university camaraderie.

posts.title: Inter-University Sports Championship
posts.desc: Inter-university athletic meet bringing together competitive teams.
posts.description: Cheer on varsity student-athletes as they contest championship trophies in track and field, football, basketball, and badminton.
posts.content: Designed to cultivate sportsmanship, athletic discipline, and healthy competition, the week-long meet welcomes collegiate teams from across the nation.
